Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the recap. A few things from procurement's side:

- Portal revalidation: yes — we require a vendor onboarding refresh for changes that increase committed spend >20%. That will be a short form in our vendor portal (link below).
- Docs we need uploaded to the portal: copy of current MSA (signed), SOC 2 Type II (redacted is fine), W-9 or tax-ID, and bank remit/payment instructions.
- For contract changes we prefer a signed addendum vs replacing the whole MSA; legal will accept your MSA_v3 addendum if the redlines are summarized in a 1-page cover memo.

I have looped Tim Johnson (accounts payable) on the thread — he will be the billing contact.

Portal: https://portal.acme-health.com/vendors/requests/1129

Can you also confirm whether the renewal price is fixed for 12 months and whether there are any setup/transfer fees for the extra capacity?
